info.name: Shiksha Setu API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Shiksha Setu backend.

1. Start the server: python manage.py runserver
2. Create the Principal once with python manage.py create_principal
3. Run `1 Sign in and accounts > Login`. The token is saved and used by every request.

Requests that create something save its id (class_id, student_id, teacher_id, exam_id ...), so the next request can use it. Dates like {{today}} are filled in for you. Greyed-out query parameters are optional: tick them to use them.

exec: const day = (n) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };
set('today', day(0)); set('plus_1', day(1)); set('plus_3', day(3)); set('plus_7', day(7));
set('plus_8', day(8)); set('plus_30', day(30)); set('minus_30', day(-30));

item.name: 0 Start here
item.description:
Run the server, then create the Principal once:

python manage.py create_principal --email you@school.in --name "Name" --password '...'

Then run `1 Sign in > Login`. It saves the tokens, and every other request uses them.

request.description: Saves `token` and `refresh`. To act as a teacher or staff member, log in with their email.
